subject.title: improve(android): make Wear store releases reproducible

question: Should Android releases with previously valid phone version-code suffixes 50–99 remain supported as legacy inputs while new paired phone/Wear releases use 01–49?
rationale: The PR changes a previously accepted persisted release identity, and maintainers need to choose whether to preserve it, migrate it, or intentionally retire it before landing a fail-closed validator.

options.title: Preserve legacy release identities
options.body: Accept existing 50–99 phone codes for validation and upgrade paths, while constraining newly allocated paired releases to 01–49.

options.title: Require an explicit migration
options.body: Retire 50–99 only with a documented, tested migration that makes affected release metadata and operator recovery unambiguous.

options.title: Pause the release-policy change
options.body: Keep the provenance improvements but defer the allocation restriction until the Android release-code policy is approved.

recommendation.title: Preserve legacy release identities
recommendation.body: Accept existing 50–99 phone codes for validation and upgrade paths, while constraining newly allocated paired releases to 01–49.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged Wear companion work established the paired Android/Wear release boundary that this version-code policy changes.
